tasks.name: cheap-drift
tasks.scopedGoal: Implement a CHEAP model-catalog drift detector for ai-gateway. 'Cheap' means it compares set membership only and issues NO chat-completion probes (zero token cost) — contrast with the existing per-model probe in services/gateway-engine/api/admin_routes.py. Deliver scripts/cheap_drift_check.py (python3, stdlib + pyyaml which is already a dep) that: (1) loads configured model aliases from litellm-config.yaml (model_list[].model_name) and optionally config/model-registry.yaml; (2) obtains the served catalog either from CLIProxy `GET {CLIPROXY_URL}/v1/models` using `CLIPROXY_API_KEY` (bearer) OR, for CI/offline/tests, from a `--catalog-file <path>` JSON file in the OpenAI /v1/models shape ({"data":[{"id":...}]}); (3) computes drift sets `configured_not_served` and `served_not_configured`; (4) prints a JSON report to stdout; (5) exits non-zero when total drift count exceeds `--threshold` (default 0), zero otherwise. Add a Make target `drift-cheap` that runs it (offline against a committed fixture is fine). Add a pytest module `tests/test_cheap_drift_check.py` covering: no-drift (exit 0), drift-over-threshold (non-zero exit), and offline --catalog-file parsing. Do NOT add any completion/probe HTTP calls and do NOT edit services/**. Commit, push, open a draft PR against main.
acceptance: scripts/cheap_drift_check.py compares configured vs served model sets with zero chat-completion calls
Offline mode via --catalog-file works and is covered by a passing pytest in tests/
Exit code is non-zero when drift exceeds --threshold and zero when within it
A draft PR against main is opened
tasks.verify:
## Setup
- python3 with pyyaml (already available). No running stack required.

## Automated
- Run the new pytest: `cd services/gateway-engine 2>/dev/null; python3 -m pytest ../../tests/test_cheap_drift_check.py -q` (or from repo root `python3 -m pytest tests/test_cheap_drift_check.py -q`) and confirm all pass.
- Run `make drift-cheap` and confirm it executes the checker.
- Confirm a no-drift catalog fixture yields exit 0 and a drifted fixture over threshold yields non-zero, and that `rg -n 'chat/completions|max_tokens' scripts/cheap_drift_check.py` finds nothing (no probing).

## Manual
- Skim scripts/cheap_drift_check.py to confirm the drift is pure set membership and the JSON report includes configured_not_served and served_not_configured.

## Gotchas
- Alias normalization: litellm uses dashes (gpt-5-4) while upstream uses dots (gpt-5.4); the checker must compare on the same normalization it documents.

tasks.name: model-new-hot-add
tasks.scopedGoal: Add a /model/new HOT-ADD capability to gateway-engine so an operator can register a new model into the RUNNING stack without a full restart. Implement `POST /model/new` (admin-key protected, reusing `_require_admin_key` exactly as the existing /admin/models routes in services/gateway-engine/api/admin_routes.py and services/gateway-engine/admin_api.py do — return the same 503 admin_key_required shape when unauthenticated) that: (1) upserts the model into the gateway-engine model registry via ModelRegistryStore (reuse ModelRegistryWriteRequest / to_record), and (2) proxies the add to LiteLLM's runtime model API by POSTing to `{litellm_url}/model/new` (LiteLLM's runtime add endpoint) so the model becomes live in LiteLLM's in-memory router immediately, forwarding the LITELLM_MASTER_KEY bearer. Also add a symmetric `POST /model/delete`. Return a structured JSON result with the registry record and the LiteLLM add outcome; if LiteLLM is unreachable, DEGRADE gracefully to a partial-success payload (registry updated, litellm_add: failed with reason) rather than a 500. Register the routes in services/gateway-engine/main.py alongside the existing admin routers. Add a pytest module (mirror the fakes in services/gateway-engine/test_gateway_engine_model_registry.py) covering success (registry upsert + LiteLLM /model/new called), missing-admin-key (503), and litellm-unreachable (partial success, no crash). Document the new endpoint under docs/openapi/ and register it per the repo's mandatory API-doc rule (see AGENTS.md / docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md). Do NOT edit scripts/** or litellm-config.yaml. Commit, push, open a draft PR against main.
acceptance: POST /model/new requires the admin key and returns the existing 503 admin_key_required shape without it
Happy path upserts the ModelRegistryStore record AND POSTs to {litellm_url}/model/new with the master key
LiteLLM-unreachable path returns a graceful partial-success payload (no 500 crash)
A pytest module covers success, missing-admin-key, and litellm-unreachable paths and passes
The endpoint is documented under docs/openapi/ and registered per the repo API-doc rule
A draft PR against main is opened
